name: Wow Extensions for WooCommerce
author: Wow Elements

sections.description:
Wow Extensions for WooCommerce is a comprehensive plugin designed to supercharge your WooCommerce store with powerful, easy-to-use extensions. Perfect for store owners who want to create flexible, fully customized shopping experiences.

Why Wow Extensions for WooCommerce?

  • Role-based pricing for different user roles
  • Enable/disable features easily from the dashboard
  • Lightweight and performance-oriented
  • Regular updates and friendly support
  • Compatible with the latest WooCommerce versions
  • Easy to configure — no coding required

Role Based Pricing

Control product pricing based on user roles. Offer different prices to wholesale customers, members, VIP users, and more — all from a simple dashboard.

  • Set role-specific regular and sale prices per product
  • Apply a global percentage or fixed discount/markup for any role
  • Hide price display for selected roles
  • Hide the Add to Cart button for selected roles
  • Works with simple and variable products

Checkout Field Editor (Pro)

Customize your WooCommerce checkout by adding, editing, reordering, and validating billing, shipping, and additional fields from the Wow Extensions dashboard.

  • Add custom billing, shipping, and additional checkout fields
  • Reorder fields and control labels, placeholders, and validation rules
  • Manage all checkout fields without editing theme or template files
  • Works with WooCommerce classic checkout

One Page Checkout (Pro)

Let customers choose products and complete checkout on a single page to reduce friction and improve conversion.

  • Embed one-page checkout anywhere with a shortcode
  • Display products in grid, list, or dropdown layouts
  • Optional checkout directly on single product pages
  • AJAX cart updates without full page reloads

Subscription (Pro)

Sell recurring products with subscription records, scheduled renewals, and customer self-service in My Account.

  • Mark simple and variable products as subscriptions with billing intervals, trials, and signup fees
  • Scheduled renewals create pending orders customers pay through your normal checkout
  • My Account subscriptions list with optional customer cancellation
  • Recurring price display in cart, checkout, and on product pages

More extensions and features are coming soon.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the wow-extensions-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active
  4. Go to Wow Extensions in your WordPress admin menu
  5. Enable the features you need and configure their settings
sections.faq:
Does your plugin support all WooCommerce themes?

Yes, Wow Extensions for WooCommerce is compatible with all WordPress themes that support WooCommerce.

What do I need to use the plugin?

Just install Wow Extensions for WooCommerce along with WooCommerce; that is all. Our plugin will provide you with all essential extensions to help you customize your store in minutes.

Does Role Based Pricing work with variable products?

Yes, role-based pricing applies to both simple and variable products.

Do you provide tutorials on the plugin?

Yes, we provide detailed documentation to support our users with thorough guidelines for our plugins and extensions.

How do I get help for any issue?

Please open a support ticket on the WordPress.org support forum for this plugin. We aim to respond within 24 hours.

How do I get updates?

Updates are delivered automatically through the standard WordPress plugin updater. You will see an update notification in your WordPress dashboard when a new version is available.
